about: Analyses written by the full price check for cards that stand out (scripts/outliers.py). Shown on the card page above the automatic findings. Edit with scripts/set_insight.py.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Slab priced barely above raw: 1.14x vs a usual 2.3x
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text: The PSA10 premium over the raw card is 1.14x against a six-month norm of about 2.3x (pokeca-chart, 2026-09-21), so the slab is cheap relative to the raw card, or raw is still priced high. The ask still rose 4% to ¥31,000 in a week when the market fell 8%, and only 7 of 20 listings sit within 15%, so the book is thin. The ask is above the Buy line (¥29,500) and your limit (¥26,000). Watch raw prices: if raw keeps falling, the slab has room to follow.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.headline: Ask jumped 7% while the rest of the market fell, on thinner trading
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.text: The lowest ask rose from ¥41,000 to ¥43,900 over a week in which my tier index fell 8%. Sales slowed sharply, from about 7.5 a day to 2.5, so the rise looks like sellers pulling cheaper listings rather than new demand. That is a guess from the data, not a confirmed cause. The ask sits above the Buy line (¥38,000) and your limit (¥35,000), so there is nothing to do; watch whether sales pick back up before treating this as a new floor.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.headline: Sales are now following the asks down
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.text:
What's happening: The lowest ask held at ¥108,000, and the sales are now coming down to it: the two latest one-copy sales, in the last 11 hours, went for ¥105,980 and ¥107,554, after most sales from 9/21 to 9/25 at ¥116,000–120,000. All 20 sampled listings are within 15% of the lowest, so the whole order book has moved, not one stray listing.

Why: A market-wide correction (PSA10 index −28% over a month) plus plenty of supply behind the card. White Flare got an official additional production run and was restocked widely through autumn 2025 (per SNKRDUNK's reprint tracker), which keeps raw copies flowing into grading. Searches found no news of a further reprint in 2026.

For you: ¥108,000 is exactly its Buy line, but the correction rule keeps it at Watch; Definitely-buy is ¥98,000. Your ¥70,000 limit remains far below.

Watch: Yesterday's call held: sales followed the asks down rather than bouncing. If the next sales print near ¥105k, the ¥108k listings will likely be undercut toward ¥100k.
